name: equityos
description: Programmable index infrastructure for tokenized stocks on Base

scripts.test:coverage:core: cd packages/core && CORE_COVERAGE_FILE=coverage/istanbul.json bun test --preload ../../scripts/core-coverage-preload.ts && cd ../.. && bun scripts/check-core-coverage.ts packages/core/coverage/istanbul.json packages/core/src
scripts.test:mutation: bun install --frozen-lockfile --cwd tools/mutation && cd packages/core && ../../tools/mutation/node_modules/.bin/stryker run ../../tools/mutation/stryker.config.mjs
scripts.test:integration: forge build --root contracts && CONTRACT_ARTIFACTS=required bun run --filter @equityos/contracts-abi test && bun run --filter @equityos/web test:integration && bun run --filter @equityos/web test:e2e:chain
